cim: Huawei unveils HarmonyOS-powered Qinyun HM650 series desktop PCs for enterprise and government users, saying they use "100% domestically made" components (Iris Deng/South China Morning Post)
cim_eredeti: Huawei unveils HarmonyOS-powered Qinyun HM650 series desktop PCs for enterprise and government users, saying they use "100% domestically made" components (Iris Deng/South China Morning Post)
szoveg_eredeti:
Tech giant expands HarmonyOS beyond laptops and tablets as it accelerates efforts to replace US technology

The tech giant said the new desktop line-up used entirely China-made components, from the processor to memory modules, making it the country’s first desktop computer to receive certification as “100 per cent domestic”, according to its website. The exact scope of the certification is unclear.
